svg.font-family: 'Visual Anything Roboto', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Invoice to ledger
svg.desc:
An invoice and its payment, the journal entries that record them, and the accounts their lines debit and credit in the general ledger.
Its long description, an outline of every shape and relation, is in “Workshop books - Invoice to ledger.md”.
